hyperedges.label: Sky & image pipeline (takram atmosphere + clouds + pmndrs post + accumulation)

nodes.label: Sea Sunset Favicon
nodes.rationale: 64x64 rounded-square app icon depicting a sun setting over layered ocean waves; a miniature emblem of the sea wallpaper scene

nodes.label: Layered Ocean Waves
nodes.rationale: Two quadratic-curve wave paths (lighter front-back depth layering) suggest ocean depth

nodes.label: Turbulence Noise Texture (turbulence.png)
nodes.description: Small tileable RGB noise texture (about 128x128) with independent, blotchy multi-octave noise in each color channel. It produces saturated rainbow patches.
nodes.rationale: A packed multi-channel noise lookup lets a shader sample several decorrelated noise values (for example UV distortion offsets) in one texture fetch, so it does not have to compute procedural noise per pixel.

nodes.label: Water Turbulence / UV Distortion
nodes.rationale: The file name and look suggest it is sampled to perturb texture coordinates for water surfaces, refraction or caustics in the sea wallpaper scene.

nodes.label: Splash screen (CSS animated waves/boat/sun)
nodes.rationale: Animations use only transform/opacity so they run on the compositor while GPU render blocks main thread

nodes.label: Procedural props (no downloaded assets)
nodes.rationale: Deviation from CC0 glTF plan: zero asset weight, per-date variety, nothing external to host

nodes.label: NaN skyline specks fix
nodes.rationale: Sea-floor exp() overflowed to infinity; mix(inf, land, 1) = NaN -> white bloom specks; clamped in GLSL+TS

nodes.label: Render today's wallpaper step (SwiftShader snapshot)
nodes.rationale: Runners have no GPU, so SwiftShader software WebGL with fewer frames; continue-on-error so site still deploys without fresh latest.jpg

nodes.label: /latest.jpg daily snapshot
nodes.rationale: Lets wallpaper tools that cannot run JavaScript fetch a plain image

nodes.label: Blender/Cycles headless (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Photoreal but needs a render step outside the browser

nodes.label: FFT ocean (Tessendorf, JONSWAP, 3 cascades)
nodes.rationale: Cascade patch sizes L, L/6.37, L/37 so tiles never align

nodes.label: Night lunar mode (moonlit atmosphere)
nodes.rationale: Moonlight is reflected sunlight, so atmosphere lit from moon direction then graded dark/blue

nodes.label: postprocessing (pmndrs) EffectComposer
nodes.rationale: Required by takram; not the three.js examples composer

nodes.label: Optional CI snapshot via SwiftShader
nodes.rationale: CI runners have no GPU; slow but acceptable for one frame (~15-20 min)

nodes.label: Tile rendering / lower-res fallback for weak devices

nodes.label: Tree variety, bark and leaf meshes
nodes.norm_label: tree variety, bark and leaf meshes

nodes.label: Date seed -> scene parameters (deterministic)
nodes.rationale: Same date = same scene everywhere; any past/future date re-renderable

nodes.label: Frame accumulation (AccumulatePass)
nodes.rationale: takram clouds TAA leaves residual noise on static camera; averaging 64 frames converges stochastic clouds

nodes.label: Decision: web-only rendering (three.js)
nodes.rationale: Fits GitHub Pages: static app, visitor's browser renders; no image storage, archive is re-render any date; still image allows seconds per frame
